hypothesis: Larger ImageNet representation and acquisition augmentation improve generalization beyond CLAHE alone.
augmentation: 90-100% random resized crop, mild affine, brightness/contrast 0.3, random autocontrast and softening; no flips
candidate_selection: Maximum validation specificity with recall >=0.98, tie by F1; includes incumbent
test_policy: Only evaluate locked winner, once; do not tune test threshold. If incumbent wins, retain existing benchmark result.
test_status: Legacy benchmark already inspected during v1-v3; this experiment cannot establish unbiased external generalization.
